statement: Substituted values are HTML-escaped by default (& < > " '), while the triple-brace form inserts the value unescaped.

faults.description: The less-than character is escaped to the greater-than entity.
Raw triple-brace values are escaped as well.
A missing comma in the escape table makes the module fail to load.

statement: In strict mode a placeholder with no value fails with MissingValueError 'missing value: <name>', and a name present with an empty-string value is not missing.

faults.description: Presence is judged by truthiness, so an empty-string value is treated as missing.
The error message drops the 'value' word.

statement: A template with an unclosed '{{' fails with TemplateSyntaxError reporting the zero-based index of the opening '{{'.

faults.description: The error reports the position after the braces instead of the opening braces.
Stale anchor for the closer definition under an older variable name.

statement: slugify lowercases the title, turns each run of non-alphanumeric characters into a single hyphen, and strips leading and trailing hyphens.

faults.description: Calls a non-existent string method, so slugify throws for any ordinary title.
Only leading hyphens are stripped, so slugs for titles like 'Hello!' keep a trailing hyphen.

statement: slugify cuts a slug longer than the limit at the limit and removes any trailing hyphen, and a limit below 1 fails with InvalidLimitError.

faults.description: The trailing hyphen left by the cut is no longer removed.
A limit of 0 is accepted instead of rejected.

statement: countWords returns the number of maximal runs of non-whitespace characters, and 0 for empty or whitespace-only text.

faults.description: countWords loops forever for any input.
Words are split on single spaces only, so tabs, newlines and repeated spaces miscount.

statement: readingTime returns whole minutes rounded up at 400 words per minute for skimmers and 200 for careful readers, with at least 1 minute for any positive count.

faults.description: Rounds down instead of up, so 201 careful words gives 1 minute.
The skimmer rate is changed from 400 to 300 words per minute.

statement: An empty day set fails with EmptyScheduleError 'at least one send day is required', and a time that is not a valid 24-hour HH:MM fails with InvalidTimeError.

faults.description: The first EmptyScheduleError message is reworded, so an empty day set reports the wrong message.
faults.find: at least one send day is required
faults.replace: at least one day is required

faults.description: The hour pattern accepts 24 to 29, so a time like 24:00 is no longer rejected.

statement: footer greets a subscriber by name, gives guests the fixed subscribe line, and rejects any other recipient kind with UnknownRecipientError.

faults.description: The subscriber footer prints the recipient kind instead of the name.
Any kind other than subscriber gets the guest footer, so unknown kinds no longer fail.
